description: This file contains utility classes and functions for processing streaming chunks of model responses, including methods for sorting chunks, building responses, combining content, handling tool calls, and calculating usage metrics within a language model or API SDK.

classes.name: ChunkProcessor
classes.description: Utility class for processing, sorting, and aggregating streaming chunks of model responses, handling hidden parameters, tool calls, content combination, and usage calculation.

methods.name: __init__(self, chunks: List, messages: Optional[list] = None)
methods.description: Initializes ChunkProcessor with list of chunks and optional messages, sorting chunks based on 'created_at' parameter if available.

methods.name: list _sort_chunks(self, chunks: list)
methods.description: Sorts chunks based on 'created_at' hidden parameter if present.

methods.name: ModelResponse update_model_response_with_hidden_params( self, model_response: ModelResponse, chunk: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None )
methods.description: Updates a ModelResponse object with hidden parameters from a specific chunk.

methods.name: str _get_chunk_id(chunks: List[Dict[str, Any]])
methods.description: Extracts the 'id' field from chunks, returns empty string if none found.

methods.name: ModelResponse build_base_response(self, chunks: List[Dict[str, Any]])
methods.description: Constructs a basic ModelResponse object from chunks, initializing choices and usage, and setting finish reasons.

methods.name: List[ChatCompletionMessageToolCall] get_combined_tool_content( self, tool_call_chunks: List[Dict[str, Any]] )
methods.description: Combines multiple tool call chunks into a list of ChatCompletionMessageToolCall objects, merging arguments and provider-specific fields.

methods.name: FunctionCall get_combined_function_call_content( self, function_call_chunks: List[Dict[str, Any]] )
methods.description: Aggregates function call content from function call chunks into a single FunctionCall object.

methods.name: ChatCompletionAssistantContentValue get_combined_content( self, chunks: List[Dict[str, Any]], delta_key: str = "content" )
methods.description: Concatenates 'content' or specified delta key from chunks into a single string content.

methods.name: Optional[List[Union["ChatCompletionThinkingBlock","ChatCompletionRedactedThinkingBlock"]]] get_combined_thinking_content( self, chunks: List[Dict[str, Any]] )
methods.description: Aggregates thinking blocks from chunks, handling 'thinking' and 'redacted_thinking' types.

methods.name: ChatCompletionAssistantContentValue get_combined_reasoning_content( self, chunks: List[Dict[str, Any]] )
methods.description: Specialized method to combine reasoning content from chunks.

methods.name: ChatCompletionAudioResponse get_combined_audio_content( self, chunks: List[Dict[str, Any]] )
methods.description: Combines audio data chunks by concatenating base64-encoded data and transcripts.

methods.name: dict _usage_chunk_calculation_helper(self, usage_chunk: Usage)
methods.description: Calculates token usage and cache info from a usage chunk.

methods.name: int count_reasoning_tokens(self, response: ModelResponse)
methods.description: Counts tokens in reasoning content of a ModelResponse.

methods.name: "UsagePerChunk" _calculate_usage_per_chunk( self, chunks: List[Union[Dict[str, Any], ModelResponse]], )
methods.description: Calculates usage metrics per chunk, including prompt, completion tokens, and cache info.

methods.name: Usage calculate_usage( self, chunks: List[Union[Dict[str, Any], ModelResponse]], model: str, completion_output: str, messages: Optional[List] = None, reasoning_tokens: Optional[int] = None, )
methods.description: Calculates total usage metrics for a list of chunks and output content, integrating prompt and response token counts.
